facts.text: Ambiente Sedona is a collection of 40 elevated Atriums perched above the natural landscape of Sedona, set on the border of the national forest.
facts.excerpt: Set on the border of the national forest, Ambiente® is a collection of 40 elevated Atriums perched above the natural landscape of Sedona.

facts.text: The Atriums are composed of floor-to-ceiling, bronze-tinted glass granting 180 degree views of the surrounding red rocks.
facts.excerpt: Composed of floor-to-ceiling, bronze-tinted glass granting 180 degree views of the surrounding red rocks, each Atrium offers a unique experience.

facts.text: Each Atrium has a rooftop deck with a fire pit and daybed.
facts.excerpt: each Atrium presents a rooftop deck, fire pit and daybed for immersive enjoyment of the outdoors

facts.text: Views from the hotel span from the Brins Mesa mountain range to ancient waterways weaving through the property.
facts.excerpt: enjoy breathtaking views that span from the massive Brins Mesa mountain range to a series of ancient waterways weaving throughout the property

facts.text: The resort's design incorporated the restoration of an ancient waterway, which runs as a water feature throughout the property.
facts.excerpt: Incorporated into the design process of the resort is the restoration of an ancient waterway, which guests enjoy as a water feature throughout the property

facts.text: The hotel says its landscape hotel is the first of its kind in North America.
facts.excerpt: Our landscape hotel is the first of its kind in North America.

facts.text: The hotel is family-operated by Mike Stevenson and his two daughters, Jennifer May and Colleen TeBrake.
facts.excerpt: As a family-operated hotel by Mike and his two daughters Jennifer May and Colleen TeBrake (Two Sister Bosses)

facts.text: Michael Stevenson purchased the property in 2016.
facts.excerpt: In a 2016 extraordinary turn of events, Michael was able to purchase a beautiful piece of property, ironically zoned for a hotel

facts.text: Each Atrium has a freestanding, two-person Hinoki tub.
facts.excerpt: Freestanding, Two-Person Hinoki Tub

facts.text: Atrium bath amenities are Byredo Gypsy Water.
facts.excerpt: Byredo® Gypsy Water® Bath Amenities

facts.text: Breakfast for two is provided each morning at Forty1 Restaurant for Atrium guests.
facts.excerpt: Breakfast provided for two, each morning at Forty 1 Restaurant.

facts.text: Ambiente does not charge any resort fees.
facts.excerpt: AMBIENTE® Does Not Charge Any Resort Fees

facts.text: Lexus guest shuttle vehicles are available for Sedona Airport and local attraction pick up and drop off.
facts.excerpt: Lexus Guest Shuttle Vehicles (Available for Sedona Airport and Local Attraction Pick Up / Drop Off)

facts.text: Sedona is one of just 20 certified Dark Sky Communities globally.
facts.excerpt: Sedona, one of the just 20 certified Dark Sky Communities globally, provides a stellar stargazing experience.

facts.text: Creekside Atriums have a creek-side deck and a rooftop terrace for stargazing.
facts.excerpt: These Atriums boast a rooftop terrace for stargazing and a creek-side deck for peaceful moments with the sound of running water.

facts.text: Creekside Atriums are fully ADA compliant.
facts.excerpt: The Creekside Atrium accommodations in Sedona are fully ADA compliant.

facts.text: Restaurant Forty1 is led by Arizona natives Chef Bri Barker and Beverage Manager Rachelle Connolly, with a local-first philosophy.
facts.excerpt: Led by Arizona natives Chef Bri Barker and Beverage Manager Rachelle Connolly, our culinary and cocktail programs are rooted in a local-first philosophy

facts.text: Forty1 serves modern American cuisine built around Verde Valley produce, Arizona-raised proteins and seasonal ingredients.
facts.excerpt: Forty1 serves modern American cuisine built around Verde Valley produce, Arizona-raised proteins, and seasonal ingredients.

facts.text: Forty1's patio is a pool-side terrace with outdoor fire pits and panoramic red rock views.
facts.excerpt: Pool-side terrace with outdoor fire pits and panoramic red rock views.

facts.text: In-room dining serves Forty1 plates to the guest's private rooftop terrace.
facts.excerpt: A curated selection of Forty1 plates, served from 7:00 AM to 9:00 PM directly to your private rooftop terrace.

facts.text: Velvet Spa offers massages, body treatments, facials, couples' rituals, sound journeys, energy work, CBD treatments, soaking baths and IV infusions.
facts.excerpt: Velvet Spa offers massages, body treatments, facials, couples’ rituals, sound journeys, energy work, CBD treatments, soaking baths, and IV infusions.

facts.text: At Velvet Spa, guests choose from six scent blends that are integrated into their treatments.
facts.excerpt: Your journey at Velvet begins with choosing from a collection of six distinctive scent blends, which will be artistically integrated into your treatments.

facts.text: The Sedona Sacred Clay Wrap uses red desert clay.
facts.excerpt: Revitalizing red desert clay is softly applied onto your skin, awakening your senses.

facts.text: Weather permitting, reiki and cranial services can be performed on the Atrium rooftop for an additional fee.
facts.excerpt: Weather permitting, reiki and cranial services can be performed on your atrium rooftop for an additional $105 per person.

facts.text: Landscape Atriums offer views such as the Coconino National Forest, the red rock formations or the flowing creeks.
facts.excerpt: You can gaze upon views like the Coconino National Forest, the iconic red rock formations, or the serene flowing creeks

facts.text: Ambiente is an adults-only property.
facts.excerpt: Ambiente is an adults-only property and welcomes guests 18 years of age and older.

facts.text: The minimum guest age is 21.
facts.excerpt:
Please note that the minimum

age for guests is 21

facts.text: Pets are welcome.
facts.excerpt: Pets are welcome.

facts.text: No pets.
facts.excerpt: No pet

facts.text: Ambiente Sedona opened to guests for the first time in 2023.
facts.excerpt: The final touches have been made and Ambiente® Sedona will finally open its doors to guests for the first time.
